arguments.content:
import pandas as pd

xls = pd.ExcelFile('budget.xlsx')
print("Sheets:", xls.sheet_names)
for name in xls.sheet_names:
    df = xls.parse(name, header=None)
    print(f"\n--- Sheet: {name} (shape {df.shape}) ---")
    print(df.to_string())

from openpyxl import load_workbook

wb = load_workbook('budget.xlsx', data_only=True)
print("Sheets:", wb.sheetnames)
for name in wb.sheetnames:
    ws = wb[name]
    print(f"\n--- Sheet: {name} (dims {ws.dimensions}) ---")
    for row in ws.iter_rows(values_only=True):
        print(row)

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

M = '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}'

with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    ws = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
    data = ws.find(M + 'sheetData')
    for row in data.findall(M + 'row'):
        r = row.get('r')
        for c in row.findall(M + 'c'):
            ref = c.get('r')
            t = c.get('t')
            f = c.find(M + 'f')
            v = c.find(M + 'v')
            ftext = f.text if f is not None else None
            vtext = v.text if v is not None else None
            print(f"r={r} {ref} t={t} formula={ftext!r} value={vtext!r}")
